notes: By voting for at least 1 Duelist in this campaign, players received 5 packs of Special Pack Vol.02 in their Gift Boxes upon their first log-in after August 31, 2020, 02:00 (EST). If a player had voted for the winner successfully, they also received 1 UR Ticket, 1 SR Ticket, and 2 R Tickets in their Gift Boxes. Additionally, among these "winners", those players also had the chance of being chosen (by lottery) to receive extra Rewards, in the form of Gems. Once a player received any of these items in their Gift Box, that player had 31 days to claim them before they expired.
The Gems were randomly distributed among the "winners" in the following fashion:
* 30 Players: 5000 Gems each (awarded in 5 separate 1000 Gem allocations)

The following cards are the possible choices the player had when redeeming a "KC Grand Tournament Champion Prediction Campaign" Card Ticket. Players had no later than December 31, 2020, 09:59 (EST), to redeem these Card Tickets before they expired.
